title: Naturality of the fixed tensor-shift comparison
statement: For any commutative condensed ring Λ, scheme X, module L on X, and morphism f : A → B in the unbounded derived category of internal Λ_X-module objects, the fixed tensor-shift comparison of [def-sfb-tate-twisted-projection-comparison] satisfies (f ⊗ id) ≫ tensorShiftIso(B).hom = tensorShiftIso(A).hom ≫ twist(f). No boundedness or constructibility hypothesis is needed.

source.place: clause (3), each constituent is a natural transformation

proof.text: Abstract the family of isomorphisms and its normalization predicate before unfolding the shared tensor bundle. Normalization makes each isomorphism equal to the native commutation isomorphism for tensorLeft and shift two. Apply NatTrans.shift_app_comm to the curried tensor natural transformation induced by f. The canonical CommShift structure of derived tensor gives exactly the stated square; transport back to the fixed normalized family.

lean.statement:
theorem tensorShiftIso_naturality (X : Scheme.{u}) (L : Modules Λ X)
    {A B : DerivedCategory (Modules Λ X)} (f : A ⟶ B) :
    tensorHom f (𝟙 _) ≫ (tensorShiftIso Λ X L B).hom =
      (tensorShiftIso Λ X L A).hom ≫ (twist Λ X L).map f
